# Om Lachake

> Personal portfolio and blog of Om Lachake, a  developer focused on creative web experiences, animations, and clean interfaces.
> Career wise, the focus is on low level code, backend infrastructures and databases.

## Site

- [Home](/): Portfolio homepage — hero section, project showcase, about, and contact form
- [Blog](/blog): Engineering blog with insights, project logs, and learning notes
- [Tags](/tags): Browse blog posts by topic
- [RSS Feed](/rss.xml): Subscribe to published blog posts

## Projects

Projects are showcased on the homepage. Each project includes a title, description, tech stack tags, live URL, and repository link.

## Contact

Contact form available at the bottom of the homepage (/#contact). Email: omlachake@pm.me

## Blog

Blog posts cover frontend development, animation (GSAP, Lenis), Astro, UI/UX, and engineering topics.
Only posts marked as published are publicly visible.
Full post list and metadata available via RSS at /rss.xml.

## Tech Stack

Built with Astro 5, React, GSAP, Lenis, Tailwind CSS v4, and SCSS.
Deployed on Netlify.
